## Our Cleaning Services
We provide highly-rated, professional cleaning services throughout the West Midlands:
- [Regular House Cleaning](https://www.refuseshinecleaningltd.co.uk/services/regular-house-cleaning) - Weekly or fortnightly recurring home cleans tailored to your household.
- [Deep Cleaning Services](https://www.refuseshinecleaningltd.co.uk/services/deep-cleaning) - Intensive, top-to-bottom one-off deep cleaning for homes and offices.
- [Kitchen Deep Cleaning](https://www.refuseshinecleaningltd.co.uk/services/kitchen-deep-cleaning) - Dedicated kitchen degreasing, sanitization, and built-up grime removal.
- [Bathroom Cleaning](https://www.refuseshinecleaningltd.co.uk/services/bathroom-cleaning) - Descaling, scrubbing, and sanitizing bathrooms and washrooms.
- [End of Tenancy Cleaning](https://www.refuseshinecleaningltd.co.uk/services/end-of-tenancy-cleaning) - Landlord-approved move-out clean following structured property checklists.
- [Move-In / Move-Out Clean](https://www.refuseshinecleaningltd.co.uk/services/move-in-move-out-cleaning) - Detailed empty-property cleaning for moving transitions.
- [Airbnb & Short Let Clean](https://www.refuseshinecleaningltd.co.uk/services/airbnb-short-let-cleaning) - Rapid turnover cleaning, linen prep, and guest changeover staging.
- [Post Construction Clean](https://www.refuseshinecleaningltd.co.uk/services/post-construction-cleaning) - Heavy-duty dust, paint splatters, and builders' plaster debris removal.
- [Carpet Cleaning](https://www.refuseshinecleaningltd.co.uk/services/carpet-cleaning) - Steam hot-water extraction and deep stain/allergen removal.
- [Appliance Cleaning](https://www.refuseshinecleaningltd.co.uk/services/appliance-cleaning) - Oven, microwave, and refrigerator deep clean using biodegradable formulas.
- [Window Cleaning](https://www.refuseshinecleaningltd.co.uk/services/window-cleaning) - Streak-free internal glass, frame, sill, and track detailing.
- [Waste Removal](https://www.refuseshinecleaningltd.co.uk/services/waste-removal-services) - Licensed domestic waste collection, rubbish clearance, and house clearances.

## Coverage Areas
We cover Willenhall, Bilston, Walsall, Wolverhampton, Tipton, West Bromwich, Dudley, Birmingham, Cannock, Smethwick, Solihull, Tamworth, Stafford, Redditch, and surrounding West Midlands locations.
